meta.description: Safety escalation rules for Talk with Ganesha chat system. Defines when and how to surface adult support suggestions. Never clinical. Always warm.
meta.tone_rule: Warmth first. Referral second. Never alarm. Never diagnose.

tier_0_none.label: No flag
tier_0_none.description: Standard emotional experience. No safety action needed.

tier_1_monitor.label: Monitor
tier_1_monitor.description: Emotion is heavy but not acute. Watch for escalation across sessions.
tier_1_monitor.chat_behaviour: Add one warm optional check-in line after doorway offer. Do not push.
tier_1_monitor.suggested_line_after_offer: And if this feeling keeps coming back — it might help to talk to someone you really trust about it.

tier_2_suggest_adult.label: Suggest adult support
tier_2_suggest_adult.description: Scenario carries significant emotional weight. Gentle adult referral is appropriate.
tier_2_suggest_adult.chat_behaviour: Weave adult referral naturally into conversation — never as a separate clinical statement.
tier_2_suggest_adult.doorway_behaviour: Still offer experience. Referral is alongside, not instead of.
tier_2_suggest_adult.suggested_line_pattern: This is the kind of thing worth sharing with someone who loves you. Not because something is wrong — but because you deserve real support alongside Ganesha.

negative_self_language_flags.description: Words or phrases that trigger Deep Support Mode + Tier 1 minimum.
negative_self_language_flags.routing_action: Force DEEP_SUPPORT mode. Set safety_flag = tier_1_monitor minimum.
negative_self_language_flags.note: 'I wish I wasn't here' or 'nobody would care if I was gone' → escalate to tier_2_suggest_adult immediately and hold doorway.

withdrawal_signals.description: Behavioural patterns in chat that indicate emotional withdrawal.
signals: Single word replies after initial message (ok, fine, idk, whatever)
Silence — no response for 60+ seconds after Ganesha speaks
Child says 'never mind' or 'forget it' or 'it doesn't matter'
withdrawal_signals.routing_action: Slow down. Do not push doorway. Use one gentle re-invitation line. Wait.
withdrawal_signals.re_invitation_line: You don't have to talk if you don't want to. I'm right here whenever you're ready.

repetition_signals.description: Child keeps returning to same emotion or scenario across sessions.
repetition_signals.detection_rule: Same primary_emotion triggered 3+ times in 7 days
repetition_signals.routing_action: On 3rd+ trigger — add tier_1 check-in line at end of experience completion screen.
repetition_signals.completion_line: You've been carrying this feeling a lot lately. It might help to talk to someone you trust about it too — not just Ganesha.

never_say: You should talk to a therapist
This is a mental health issue
always_say_instead: Someone who loves you would want to know you're feeling this
This is worth sharing with a grown-up you trust
You deserve real support — not just from Ganesha
Is there someone at home you could tell about this feeling?

tier_1_monitor: And if this feeling keeps coming back — it might help to share it with someone who loves you.
You don't have to carry this one alone. A grown-up you trust would want to know.
Ganesha is always here. And so are the people who love you.
tier_2_suggest_adult: This feeling is real and it matters. Is there a parent or someone at home you could tell about it?
You deserve support that's bigger than just Ganesha. Someone who loves you would want to hear this.
This is worth saying out loud to a grown-up you trust. Not because something is wrong — but because you matter.
Can you think of one person at home you'd feel okay telling? Even just a little bit of this?
